```{r mutation analysis}
asvs_translated <- R.asv %>%
  mutate(
    AA = case_when(target_id == "Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B" ~ 
                     as.character(
                       Biostrings::translate(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(substr(seq,3,193-2))))),
                   target_id == "Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2" ~
                     as.character(
                       Biostrings::translate(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(substr(seq,1,182-2)))))))

### we need to identify the various codons present in this data

### codon 281 is 

amp1 = asvs_translated %>% filter(target_id == "Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B")
for(codon_ix in 281:(281+63-1)){ # we pull these from the initial amplicon
  amp1[,paste0("codon", codon_ix)] = substring(amp1$AA, codon_ix-281+1, codon_ix-281+1)
  ## calculate frequency for entire population
}

amp1_long = amp1 %>% pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("codon"),
                                  names_to = "CodonID", values_to = "AA_codon")

### next we can run dcifer
library(dcifer)
amp1_long_coi <- amp1_long %>% left_join(COI_table, by = join_by(specimen_id))
dcifer_input_amp1 = formatDat(amp1_long_coi, svar = "specimen_id", lvar = "CodonID", avar = "AA_codon")
dcifer_freqs_amp1 = calcAfreq(dcifer_input_amp1, amp1_long_coi$estimated_coi)
str(dcifer_freqs_amp1, list.len = 2)
dcifer_freqs_df_amp1 = data.frame(unlist(dcifer_freqs_amp1)) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("CodonID.AA") %>%
  mutate(CodonID = str_split_i(CodonID.AA, "\\.", 1),
         AA = str_split_i(CodonID.AA, "\\.", 2),
         codon_numeric = as.numeric(substring(CodonID, 6, 9)))

amp1_reference_table = data.frame(CodonID = 281:(281+63-1),
                                  "reference" = str_split(V31B_amp, ""))
colnames(amp1_reference_table) = c("CodonID", "reference")

dcifer_freqs_amp1 = dcifer_freqs_df_amp1 %>% left_join(amp1_reference_table, by = join_by(codon_numeric == CodonID))  %>% 
  mutate(match = AA == reference) %>% mutate(cleaned_AA = ifelse(match, NA, AA))

### REPEAT FOR AMPLICON 2

for(codon_ix in 337:(337+60-1)){ # we pull these from the initial amplicon
  amp2[,paste0("codon", codon_ix)] = substring(amp2$AA, codon_ix-337+1, codon_ix-337+1)
```

```{r malaria.em phasing}
check_match <- function(string, correct_seq){
  ans <- ""
  for(char_ix in 1:nchar(correct_seq)){
    if(substring(correct_seq, char_ix, char_ix)==substring(string, char_ix, char_ix)){
      char = "_"
    }
    else {char = substring(string, char_ix, char_ix)}
    ans <- paste(ans, char, sep="")
  }
  return(ans)
}

malaria.em.phasing_AA <- read.csv("DATA/phasing_results/ALL_phasing_AA.csv") %>% 
  mutate(pID = paste(gt_id, province)) %>% dplyr::select(-X, -gt_id, -id_col)

malaria.em.phasing_AA <- malaria.em.phasing_AA %>% 
  filter(province != "Lunda Sul") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = target_id, values_from = c(seq)) %>%
  mutate(
    AA_1 = `Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B`,
    AA_2 = `Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2`) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    distance1 =  adist(AA_1, V31B_amp)[1],
    distance2 = adist(AA_2, V32_amp)[1],
    total_distance = distance1 + distance2
    ) %>% dplyr::select(-c(`Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B`, `Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2`, pID, distance1, distance2))

cat("There are", n_distinct(malaria.em.phasing_AA %>% 
                              filter(freq > 1e-5) %>%
                              mutate(total_seq = paste0(AA_1, AA_2)) %>% pull(total_seq)),
    "unique multilocus haplotypes at a frequency of at least 10^-5")
```

```{r Figure 2A}
### Making figure 2A
myplots <- vector('list', 5)
i <- 1
for(country in c("Angola", "Eswatini", "Namibia", "South Africa", "Zambia")){
  df <- malaria.em.phasing_PLOT_BAR %>% filter(COUNTRY == country) %>%
    group_by(NAME) %>%
    summarise(cat_0 = sum(total[total_distance==0]),
              cat_1_4 = sum(total[total_distance %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)]),
              cat_5_7 = sum(total[total_distance %in% c(5, 6, 7)]),
              cat_8_10 = sum(total[total_distance %in% c(8, 9, 10)]),
              cat_plus = sum(total[total_distance >11])) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = contains("cat"))
  plot <- ggplot(df) + 
    geom_bar(aes(x = NAME, y = value, fill = name), stat = "identity", position = position_fill(reverse = TRUE)) + 
    labs(color = NULL) + ggtitle(country) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) +
    ylab("Proportion of Parasites") + xlab(NULL) + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical",
                                                                       plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
                                                                       axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5, hjust=1)) 
  plot
  myplots[[i]] <- plot + scale_fill_brewer(labels = c("0", "1-4", "5-7", "8-10", "11+"),
                                           palette = "Purples",
                                             name = "Edit Distance\nto 3D7")
  i <- i +1
}
```

## Figure Graphing

```{r Mapping CSP Max per Locus}

map_africa <- function(dataset, col, name, by.x, by.y = "province_name", 
                       legend_name = "Med. Edit Dist", color=NA){
  merged <<- merge(dataset, ESA_data, by.x = by.x, by.y = by.y)
  merged_graph <<- merged %>% 
    group_by(!!rlang::sym(by.x)) %>% 
    dplyr::summarize(VALUE = median(!!rlang::sym(col)),
            geometry = dplyr::first(geometry))
  plot <-  ggplot() + 
    geom_sf(data=shpfile_africa, fill="grey") +
    geom_sf(data = merged_graph, aes(fill=VALUE, geometry = geometry)) +
    geom_sf(data=shpfile_africa, fill=NA, lwd = 1) +
    coord_sf(ylim = c(0, -40), xlim = c(10, 45), expand = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(name) + 
    labs(fill = legend_name) +
    theme_minimal()  + scale_fill_viridis_c(option="G")
  return(plot)
}
```

```{r Allele Frequency}
##adding in phasing
correct_seq <- paste(DV10, Th2R, Th3R, sep="")

# TODO fix distances so that they're based on just seq 1 + seq 2

malaria.em.COUNTRY.phasing <- read.csv("DATA/phasing_results/ALL_phasing_country_level_AA.csv") %>% 
  mutate(pID = paste(gt_id, province)) %>% dplyr::select(-X, -gt_id, -id_col) %>%
  filter(province != "Lunda Sul") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = target_id, values_from = c(seq)) %>%
  mutate(
    AA_1 = `Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B`,
    AA_2 = `Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2`) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    distance1 =  adist(AA_1, V31B_amp)[1],
    distance2 = adist(AA_2, V32_amp)[1],
    total_distance = distance1 + distance2
    ) %>% dplyr::select(-c(`Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B`, `Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2`, pID, distance1, distance2)) %>%
  mutate(DV10_col =  substring(AA_1, 293-281+offset + 1, 302 - 281+offset +1),
         Th2R_col = substring(AA_1, 311-281+offset, 327 - 281+offset),
         Th3R_col = substring(AA_2, 352-337+offset, 363-337+offset),
         total_distance_epitopes = (adist(DV10_col, DV10) +
                                      adist(Th2R_col, Th2R) +
                                      adist(Th3R_col, Th3R)),
         mutated_seqs = paste(
           unlist(lapply(DV10_col, check_match, DV10)),
           unlist(lapply(Th2R_col, check_match, Th2R)),
           unlist(lapply(Th3R_col, check_match, Th3R)), sep = "   ")) %>%
  mutate(avg = mean(freq)) %>%
  group_by(mutated_seqs, province) %>%
  summarize(freq = sum(freq), 
            n_contribs = n(),
            avg = sum(avg),
            total_distance = mean(total_distance_epitopes))

top_seqs <- malaria.em.COUNTRY.phasing %>% group_by(mutated_seqs) %>% summarize(median_freq = median (freq)) %>% slice_max(median_freq, n = 20)

## fisher's exact test

haplotype_agreement_chi2_L1 <- R.asv %>% filter(target_id == "Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B") %>%
  group_by(My_Regions, seq) %>% summarize(count = n())

province_list <- unique(malaria.em.phasing_AA$province)
haplotype_agreement_chi2_results_L1 = data.frame(p1 = c(), p2 = c(), chi2.p = c())
for(p1 in province_list){
  for(p2 in province_list){
    d1 = haplotype_agreement_chi2_L1 %>% filter(My_Regions == p1)
    d2 = haplotype_agreement_chi2_L1 %>% filter(My_Regions == p2)
    d_full = full_join(d1, d2, by = c("seq", "My_Regions")) %>% 
      mutate(count.x = replace_na(count.x, 0),
             count.y = replace_na(count.y, 0))
    test_table = cbind(d_full$count.x, d_full$count.y)
    chi2 = chisq.test(test_table)
    fisher = fisher.test(d_full$count.x, d_full$count.y, simulate.p.value = TRUE)
    haplotype_agreement_chi2_results_L1 = 
      rbind(haplotype_agreement_chi2_results_L1, c(p1, p2, chi2$p.value, fisher$p.val))
  }
}

haplotype_agreement_chi2_L2 <- R.asv %>% filter(target_id == "Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2") %>%
  group_by(My_Regions, seq) %>% summarize(count = n())

haplotype_agreement_chi2_results_L2 = data.frame(p1 = c(), p2 = c(), chi2.p = c())
for(p1 in province_list){
  for(p2 in province_list){
    d1 = haplotype_agreement_chi2_L2 %>% filter(My_Regions == p1)
    d2 = haplotype_agreement_chi2_L2 %>% filter(My_Regions == p2)
    d_full = full_join(d1, d2, by = c("seq", "My_Regions")) %>% 
      mutate(count.x = replace_na(count.x, 0),
             count.y = replace_na(count.y, 0))
    test_table = cbind(d_full$count.x, d_full$count.y)
    chi2 = chisq.test(test_table)
    fisher = fisher.test(d_full$count.x, d_full$count.y, simulate.p.value = TRUE)
    haplotype_agreement_chi2_results_L2 = rbind(haplotype_agreement_chi2_results_L2, c(p1, p2, chi2$p.value, fisher$p.val))
  }
}

haplotype_agreement_results <- rbind(haplotype_agreement_chi2_results_L1 %>% mutate(target = "T1") %>%
                                       setNames(c("p1", "p2", "chi2.pvalue", "fisher.pvalue", "target")),
                                     haplotype_agreement_chi2_results_L2 %>% mutate(target = "T2") %>%
                                       setNames(c("p1", "p2", "chi2.pvalue", "fisher.pvalue", "target"))) %>%
  filter(p1 < p2) %>%
  mutate(chi2.pvalue.adj = p.adjust(chi2.pvalue, method = "BH"),
         fisher.pvalue.adj = p.adjust(fisher.pvalue, method = "BH")) %>%
  mutate(Fisher.signif = fisher.pvalue.adj < 0.05)
```

```{r key snps}
### Key SNP Positions 299, 301, 317, 354, 356, 359, and 361

## 299 + 301 are in DV10

## 317 in Th2R

## 354, 356, 359, 361 in Th3R

neafsey_match <- function(mutated_seq, target){
  if(target == "DV10"){
    key_sites = c(299, 301)
    start = 294
    end = 303
  }
  
  if(target == "Th2R"){
    key_sites = c(317)
    start = 311
    end = 327
  }
  
  if(target == "Th3R"){
    key_sites = c(354, 356, 359, 361)
    start = 352
    end = 363
  }
  ret = ""
  for(ix in seq(start, end)){
    if(ix %in% key_sites){
      add_char = substring(mutated_seq, ix-start+1, ix-start+1)
      if(target == "DV10"){
        print(add_char)
      }
      ret = paste0(ret, add_char)
    }
    else{ret = paste0(ret, ".")}
  }
  return(ret)
}
malaria.em.TOTAL.phasing  <- malaria.em.TOTAL.phasing %>% mutate(mutated_seq_DV10.neafsey = 
                                      unlist(lapply(mutated_seq_DV10, neafsey_match, "DV10")),
         mutated_seq_Th2R.neafsey = 
                                      unlist(lapply(mutated_seq_Th2R, neafsey_match, "Th2R")),
         mutated_seq_Th3R.neafsey = 
                                      unlist(lapply(mutated_seq_Th3R, neafsey_match, "Th3R"))) %>%
  mutate(mutated_seqs.neafsey = paste(mutated_seq_DV10.neafsey, mutated_seq_Th2R.neafsey, mutated_seq_Th3R.neafsey, sep = "   ")) %>%
  mutate(neafsey_distance = (nchar(paste0(DV10, Th2R, Th3R))) -
           str_count(mutated_seqs.neafsey, "_") - # remove matching
           str_count(mutated_seqs.neafsey, "\\.")) # remove irrelevant
```

## Heterozygosity

Heterozygosity = (n/n-1)(1-sum(p^2))
n = number of samples
p = allele frequency of each allele

```{r heterozygosity}
## MALARIA EM MAIN FIGURE

  summarise(n = mean(final_size),
         p2sum = sum(freq**2),
         He = (n/(n-1))*(1-p2sum))
```

_+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Source for this calc: https://bios1140.github.io/understanding-fst-the-fixation-index.html

F = (Ht - Hs) / (Ht)
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
For simplicity, imagine we are examining two populations only. With this formula,  
Ht is the expected heterozygosity when the two populations are considered as one large meta-population.  
Hs is the average expected heterozygosity in the two populations.

```{r FST}


### very similar to calculating He

Fst <- data.frame(p1 = c(), p2 = c(), val = c())
for(p1 in province_list){
  for(p2 in province_list){
    full_pop <- malaria.em.phasing_AA %>% filter(province %in% c(p1, p2))
    cat("p1", p1, "p2", p2)
    ns <- sample_size %>% filter(My_Regions %in% c(p1, p2))
    print(nrow(ns))
    ns <- sum(ns$final_size)
    full_pop <- full_pop %>% group_by(AA_1, AA_2, .groups = 'keep') %>% dplyr::summarize(
      freq = ifelse(nrow(.)==2, mean(freq), mean(freq)/n_distinct(province))
    )
    summary <- full_pop %>% group_by(TRUE) %>% dplyr::summarize(
         p2sum = sum(freq**2),
         He = (ns / (ns-1))*(1-p2sum))
    val <- summary$He
    Fst <- rbind(Fst, c(p1, p2, val))
    #print(full_pop)
    #exit
  }
}
```

## Generating Dataframes

```{r connectivity}
R.asv <- read.csv("DATA/ExportAllelesCSP_ASV.txt", sep="\t")
#metadata <- read.csv("specimen_metadata.tsv", sep="\t")
R.asv <- merge(R.asv, metadata, by.x="FieldID", by.y="form.participant_id")

library(dcifer)

#COI_table <- read.csv("coi_table.tsv", sep = "\t")
#COI_table$coi <- as.numeric(COI_table$coi)

#281 to 343
V31B_amp = "QGHNMPNDPNRNVDENANANSAVKNNNNEEPSDKHIKEYLNKIQNSLSTEWSPCSVTCGNGIQ"
DV10 = substring(V31B_amp, 293-281+1, 302 - 281+1)
Th2R = substring(V31B_amp, 311-281+1, 327 - 281+1)

#337 to 396
V32_amp = "TCGNGIQVRIKPGSANKPKDELDYANDIEKKICKMEKCSSVFNVVNSSIGLIMVLSFLFL"
Th3R = substring(V32_amp, 352-337+1, 363-337+1)

#checked for accuracy!
csp.Th2R=R.asv %>% 
  filter(Locus=="Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B") %>% 
  dplyr::select(FieldID, Locus,ASV) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(ASV_fixed=str_replace_all(ASV,"CAGCAATTGTTGGCA","CAGCATTGTTGGCA"),
         region = "Th2R")%>%  # replace insertion observed in 1 ASV
  mutate(ASV_cropped = substr(ASV_fixed,3,193-2), # get rid of partial codons at beginning and end of ASV
         AA = as.character(Biostrings::translate(Biostrings::reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(ASV_cropped)))), #translate full ASV
         AA_cropped = substring(AA, 311-281+1, 327 - 281+1),
         first_codon = 311,
         last_codon = 327) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(distance = adist(AA_cropped, Th2R)[1],
         distance_prop = distance/nchar(Th2R)
         )

#checked for accuracy (slack message)
csp.DV10=R.asv %>% 
  filter(Locus=="Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B") %>% 
  dplyr::select(FieldID, Locus,ASV) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(ASV_fixed=str_replace_all(ASV,"CAGCAATTGTTGGCA","CAGCATTGTTGGCA"),
         region = "DV10")%>%  # replace insertion observed in 1 ASV
  mutate(ASV_cropped = substr(ASV_fixed,3,193-2), # get rid of partial codons at beginning and end of ASV
         AA = as.character(Biostrings::translate(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(ASV_cropped)))), #translate full ASV
         AA_cropped = substring(AA, 293-281+1, 302 - 281+1),
         first_codon = 293,
         last_codon = 302) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(distance = adist(AA_cropped, DV10)[1],
         distance_prop = distance/nchar(DV10)
         )

#checked for accuracy
csp.Th3R=R.asv %>% 
  filter(Locus=="Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2") %>% 
  dplyr::select(FieldID, Locus,ASV) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(ASV_fixed=ASV,
         region = "Th3R")%>%  # no fix needed for this amplicon
  mutate(ASV_cropped = substr(ASV_fixed,1,182-2),
         AA = as.character(Biostrings::translate(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(ASV_cropped)))),
         AA_cropped = substring(AA, 352-337+1, 363-337+1),
         first_codon = 352,
         last_codon = 363)%>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(distance = adist(AA_cropped, Th3R)[1],
         distance_prop = distance/nchar(Th3R)
  )

#AA_2 <- merge(csp.DV10, csp.Th2R, by="FieldID", suffixes = c(".DV10", ".Th2R"))
#AA_2 <- merge(AA_2, csp.Th3R, by="FieldID", suffixes = c("", ".Th3R"))

csp.translated_1b <- rbind(csp.DV10, csp.Th2R) %>% merge(R.asv%>% 
  filter(Locus=="Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B"), by=c("FieldID", "ASV"))

csp.translated2 <- csp.Th3R %>% merge(R.asv%>%filter(Locus=="Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2"), by = c("FieldID", "ASV"))
  
csp.translated <- rbind(csp.translated_1b, csp.translated2)


csp.max.per.locus=csp.translated %>%
  group_by(FieldID,region) %>% 
  filter(Reads>5,Reads/sum(Reads)>0.01) %>% 
  group_by(FieldID) %>% 
  filter(n_distinct(region)==3) %>% 
  group_by(FieldID,region) %>% 
  dplyr::summarize(m = max(distance))


csp.locus=csp.translated %>%
  group_by(FieldID,region) %>% 
  filter(Reads>5,Reads/sum(Reads)>0.01) %>% 
  group_by(FieldID) %>% 
  filter(n_distinct(region)==3) 

### NEED TO FIX CSP.LOCUS doesn't exist in this version
csp.locus <- merge(csp.locus, COI_table, by.x = "FieldID", by.y="specimen_id")
perfect_prevalence <- merge(csp.locus, country_key_map, by.x="facility_province", by.y="Provinces_Contained_Metadata")

contains_3D7 <- perfect_prevalence %>% group_by(FieldID, region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(contains_3D7 = ifelse(min(distance)==0, TRUE, FALSE),
            only_3D7 = ifelse(max(distance)==0, TRUE, FALSE))

csp.L1=R.asv %>% 
  filter(Locus=="Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B") %>% 
  dplyr::select(FieldID, Locus,ASV) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(ASV_fixed=str_replace_all(ASV,"CAGCAATTGTTGGCA","CAGCATTGTTGGCA"),
         region = "Locus 1")%>%  # replace insertion observed in 1 ASV
  mutate(ASV_cropped = substr(ASV_fixed,3,193-2), # get rid of partial codons at beginning and end of ASV
         AA = as.character(Biostrings::translate(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(ASV_cropped)))), #translate full ASV
  ) %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(distance = adist(AA, V31B_amp)[1]
  )


csp.L2=R.asv %>% 
  filter(Locus=="Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2") %>%

  mutate(ASV_cropped = substr(ASV_fixed,1,182-2),
         AA = as.character(Biostrings::translate(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(ASV_cropped)))))%>%

  )

contains_3D7_bothloci <- rbind(csp.L1, csp.L2) %>%
```

```{r out.width = "100%"}
# Get the vector of sample IDs associated with this cluster
get_cluster_samples <- function(cluster) {
  cluster %>%
    tidygraph::activate(nodes) %>%
    as_tibble() %$%
    sample_id
}



# Add cluster IDs and sizes to a network
add_cluster_info <- function(network) {
  network %>%
    tidygraph::activate(nodes) %>%
    mutate(cluster_id = tidygraph::group_components()) %>%
    group_by(cluster_id) %>%
    mutate(cluster_size = n()) %>%
    ungroup()
}



# Read in relatedness network ------------------------------------------
contains_3D7 <- read.csv("contains_3D7_bothloci.csv")

contains_3D7 <-  contains_3D7 %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X) %>%
  #pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = c(contains_3D7, only_3D7))  %>% 
  mutate(D7 = ifelse(only_3D7, "Only 3D7", 
                     ifelse(contains_3D7, "Contains 3D7", "No 3D7"))) %>% 
  mutate(D7 = factor(D7, levels = c("No 3D7", "Contains 3D7", "Only 3D7")))

sample_network <- read_rds(inp$sample_network)
sample_network <- sample_network %>% activate(nodes) %>%
  left_join(contains_3D7, by=join_by(sample_id == FieldID))

sample_network_0_25 <- read_rds(inp_0_25$sample_network)
sample_network_0_25 <- sample_network_0_25 %>% activate(nodes) %>%
  left_join(contains_3D7, by=join_by(sample_id == FieldID))

# Separate the graph into clusters of high relatedness -----------------
alpha_val <- 0.05
if (inp$rnull == 1) {
  sample_network_highrel <- sample_network %>%
    tidygraph::activate(edges) %>%
    filter(btwn_host_rel >= inp$rnull, p_adjust >= alpha_val)
} else {
  sample_network_highrel <- sample_network %>%
    tidygraph::activate(edges) %>%
    filter(btwn_host_rel >= inp$rnull, p_adjust >= alpha_val)
}
sample_network_highrel_wcomp <- sample_network_highrel %>%
  add_cluster_info()



if (inp_0_25$rnull == 1) {
  sample_network_highrel_0_25 <- sample_network_0_25 %>%
    tidygraph::activate(edges) %>%
    filter(btwn_host_rel >= inp_0_25$rnull, p_adjust >= alpha_val)
} else {
  sample_network_highrel_0_25 <- sample_network_0_25 %>%
    tidygraph::activate(edges) %>%
    filter(btwn_host_rel >= inp_0_25$rnull, p_adjust >= alpha_val)
}
sample_network_highrel_wcomp_0_25 <- sample_network_highrel_0_25 %>%
```

### Do SEPARATE per loci


```{R taij. D}
library(pegas)
library(ape)
#setwd("C://Users/zgottho2/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/Collaboration with Dr. Wesolowski/CSP project/")
#setwd("C://Users/zoeor/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/Collaboration with Dr. Wesolowski/CSP PAPER/")
setwd("/Users/gotthold/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/Collaboration with Dr. Wesolowski/CSP PAPER")
## effective size is from coi_provinces

TD  <- R.asv

library(msa)
taji_T1 <- data.frame(province = c(), taij = c())
for(p in province_list){
  TD_p <- TD %>% dplyr::filter(My_Regions == p) %>% 
    filter(Locus == "Pf3D7_03_v3-221463-221712-1B")
  input <- msa(DNAStringSet(TD_p$ASV))
  t <- tajima.test(as.DNAbin(input))
  taji_T1 <- rbind(taji_T1, c(p, t$D, t$Pval.normal, t$Pval.beta))
}


taji_T2 <- data.frame(province = c(), taij = c())
for(p in province_list){
  TD_p <- TD %>% filter(My_Regions == p) %>% 
    filter(Locus == "Pf3D7_03_v3-221295-221532-2")
  input <- msa(DNAStringSet(TD_p$ASV))
  t <- tajima.test(as.DNAbin(input))
  taji_T2 <- rbind(taji_T2, c(p, t$D, t$Pval.normal, t$Pval.beta))
}
colnames(taji_T1) <- c("province", "TD", "pval.norm", "pval.beta")
colnames(taji_T2) <- c("province", "TD", "pval.norm", "pval.beta")
taji <- rbind(taji_T1 %>% mutate(target = "DV10-Th2R"), 
              taji_T2 %>% mutate(target = "Th3R"))


write.csv(taji, "FIGURES/taji.D.results.csv", row.names = F)
```
